I told Tobias the ticket is #88412, as a reply to his message. Tobias raised it himself in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, and he's a member of that channel. The ticket covers the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet that froze on the BOL barcode scan at Door 6. Their night shift lead said it hung when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests.

I couldn't find any later updates on whether it's been fixed in the channels Tobias can see.
